title: Settling
description: A settling on the wire: content laid over a base, one charge value per cell. The base is the key set; the content fiber is the Charge/FOUR bilattice of @lenticule-science/articulating, named by its own four value names. The theorem-locus is Obsmetrologia/Settlement.lean.

additionalProperties.title: Charge value
additionalProperties.description: absurd = nothing known; potential = evidence for; active = evidence against; stable = told both.
